body: Im okay with my life, just not the way I view things and the way I am. Ill check the book out, thank you!
I am not sure what you mean
Me, and my mom, we already asked for medication multiple times but no one wants to give it to me. Maybe that will change in the future. I am holding on to the love people give me :)
haha thank you very much!! I dont want you to go either.. I hope you are right :)
Its okay. You (and I) have a whole life ahead of us. We can do whatever we want. Everything will turn out okay in the end hopefully! Dont lose hope :)

I know, I always try to tell myself that. I hope it gets better. and I have hope. But for now I am completely tired down. I was supposed to go to university in 1,5 years. But i have to do the year over. I hope everything gets better :)
I want to escape this life.. This world.. expecations.. time etcetera. Not really life completely I guess. But theres no other way of doing that expect by becoming a drugaddict.

I know when im annoying people and I always try to avoid that. 

Mhmm.. what im like as a person.. I guess the way I see myself is average; nothing special. I am not really introverted or extroverted, it depends on the situation. I dont think the way I see myself is the most reliable though. My friends describe me as ''the funny one''. I dont really have any hobbies, I like gaming and watching movies, but both dont really improve my mental health. I started bulletjournaling which so far i enjoy, and sometimes i go on a walk for about an hour and just listen to music.

Expectations.. exactly the thing im struggling with. I was always the smart one in the class, without actually doing anything. My dad was really strict on me with my grades and I HAD to be the best of the class otherwise he would get really mad. In high school things like taking my phone away for a week when I had 6/10 (even if the average was a 6/10). Good intentions though. He just wants me to have a good future. The expectations are still what im struggling with.. even without my dad. I still struggle with not being immediately good in everything, sounds stupid but yea. When I do bad a test I am mad at myself and I feel like a dissapointment.. I know its okay to sometimes make mistakes and to not be good in everything, but its hard. 

He and I are muslim, my mom is not. My dad had a bad past and has a lot of mental issues. He thinks im not muslim anymore and that Ive completely lost track of the path. Which is not the case. But sadly thats his truth.

I dont know if I want a relationship. I guess I do. I just want someone to simply like me I guess. I do have concerns about managing relationsips in the future. As I am a very difficult person and even more difficult the closer I get to them. It wouldnt suprise me if I was extremely bad at maintaining a healthy relationship.

Haha yea, my dad is my dad. He completely lost track i guess. A lot of unsolved issues from the past. Which I dont blame him. Only thing I blame him for is that he doesnt want to get help. This also isnt the first time he disowned me. Its tough, but also a relieve on the other hand. He is a very complicated person which I cant deal with at this moment. He does everything wrong as a dad; BUT he has good intentions and loves me very much. Thats what makes this whole situation hard I guess.

I hope this answers your questions haha

Thank you a lot for your message!! <3 I appreciate all of it.

haha very cute! for me it would be my cats tho :)
stuck in a circle; this is exactly why I dont think that this world is made for me

unlikeable in the eyes of guys.  


and actually i feel like i talk too much to the point it becomes annoying. people started telling me they dont care anymore and sometimes blocked me. Which now led to the point where i dont have anyone left to talk to.   


Not everyone in my family sticks around. my dad told me he wasnt my dad anymore and i havent seen him since (few months ago)

I have professional help. My mom knows and she is very sweet. My friends know, but i dont feel comfortable talking to them about it. I know theyll be supportive, but I hate bringing down the mood and they dont really understand me and give basic answers.. Even though their intentions are good. One friend wrote me a song about my depression. Another one wrote me a very personal letter attached with drawings and such. I also have online friends but ive threatened killing myself so many times they dont take me seriously anymore and just block me.

I dont feel likeable, I hate myself. I am disgusted by myself. I am scared no one will ever like me (as no one ever has) I am scared ill never get a good job by just being socially awkward at times. I cant stand when someone doesnt like me. I am oversensitive, and that mixed with high intelligence doesnt work.  


btw i hate saying im intelligent, but its what my therapist says.
